why: Adds to a unit's footnotes the mod of each part of its detachment rules whose own needs it meets (unitDetParts), cited as the rule (Blood Tithe) with the part's own when ("Daemonic Rage active (3BTP)"). For this list: Daemonic Rage's [LANCE] on Skarbrand, the Bloodthirster, both Flesh Hounds and the Lord + Berzerkers unit (a BLOOD LEGIONS unit by the Lord, 02.05.01), on all of its melee weapons as "Melee weapons equipped by BLOOD LEGIONS units" says; not on Angron, the Daemon Prince, Goremongers, Jakhals or the Master of Executions. The rest is unchanged signed-off code; the Damage tab reads "[LANCE]" (dmEffects).

unitDetRules(u) (rule needs: any BLOOD LEGIONS / WORLD EATERS) then each part whose needs matches(u) by the unit's keywords: a unit with any model with the keyword meets it (02.05.01, 19.03), right for Daemonic Rage, Boon of Blood and Might of Khorne ("BLOOD LEGIONS units") and for Enraged Abjuration (every model of the list is BLOOD LEGIONS or WORLD EATERS).

Adds one "When targeted" line per part with a def (Enraged Abjuration on every unit, Boon of Blood on the BLOOD LEGIONS units incl. the Lord + Berzerkers unit), naming Blood Tithe; no phase filter, right as they last "until the end of the battle". The shield loop shows Blessing of Burning Blood on each WORLD EATERS unit when another BLOOD LEGIONS unit is in the list (here Skarbrand, Bloodthirster, Flesh Hounds), as the TARGET needs. Rest unchanged signed-off code.
